text: When someone leaves, their visits, clients and tasks need a new owner, and their login has to end on time. Offboard does all of that in one place.
The one thing to remember: use Offboard, not just Deactivate. Set the last day and hand over their visits, households and tasks.
Dr. Riley Rivera is leaving us. Pick her in Staff.
On her Profile tab, click Offboard.
Set her last day: next Friday.
Nothing changes until midnight that night. Then her login ends and she's signed out everywhere. Her records, signatures and invoices stay as they are.
Her two open tasks go to Dr. Ortiz, and so will any automatic tasks meant for her.
Three visits are still booked with her after that day.
They stay booked, and a Rebook task is made so a client liaison can move them. No client is emailed.
The Chens' primary doctor moves to Dr. Ortiz. No email or text goes to clients.
Tess usually rides with Dr. Rivera. Move her to Dr. Ortiz.
If she's a client too, find her household here, so her staff pricing ends on her last day.
Done. Until her last day she works as normal, and the staff list shows the date.
After the last day she's hidden from staff lists and pickers. Show deactivated brings her back into view. Reports keep her name for the days she worked.
If plans change before her last day, Cancel offboarding is right here on her Profile tab.
The most common mistakes: deactivating someone without handing over their tasks, so the tasks go nowhere, and emailing clients about a new doctor before the visits are moved.
Remember: use Offboard. Set the last day, and hand over their visits, households and tasks.
